body.description: SAL, a teenage boy scavenger hero of post-collapse Texas: messy brown hair, worn leather cap with brass goggles pushed up, red bandana, tan work jacket with shearling collar, patched denim trousers, worn boots, tool pouch on belt. gritty realistic post-apocalyptic survival game sprite, realistic proportions, heavy grime and dust, desaturated rust palette, harsh light, detailed fabric folds. single character, full body, standing, facing the viewer, game sprite, transparent background
